description: Defines the BreadcrumbItem class used for representing breadcrumb navigation elements in a web application. It includes fields such as id, label, url, and itemType, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BreadcrumbItem
classes.description: A Java class that represents an item in a breadcrumb navigation trail, including its label, URL, identifier, and item type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Returns the type of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Sets the type of the breadcrumb item.
